topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session, connects the topic to histopathology practicals, and outlines the lecture's learning objectives.

topics.label: Viral Origins and Assays of Transforming Oncogenes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the investigation of tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and establish the laboratory assays used to test transforming gene activity.

topics.label: Classification and Mechanisms of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the major classes of cancer-associated mutations and illustrate their functional effects on cellular regulation and protein activity.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Sequence and Chromosomal Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the molecular defects and cellular consequences underlying sequence and chromosomal instability in cancer cells.

topics.label: Multi-Step Tumor Progression and Hereditary Predisposition
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how multi-step mutation acquisition and inherited genetic predispositions dictate the progression and evolution of tumors.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer wraps up the lecture, provides recommended reading, and previews the upcoming session.
